item.title: Industrial action suspended – further details
item.description: On Wednesday 11 November, an agreement was reached between the university and UCU colleagues. We are pleased to confirm that this means that the current period of industrial action has been suspended.

item.title: Microsoft outage affecting Outlook, SharePoint, Teams and Copilot
item.description: A global Microsoft outage is affecting a number of our Microsoft 365 services, including Outlook, Teams, SharePoint and Copilot.

item.title: Industrial action suspended
item.description: We are pleased to announce a suspension to the current industrial action after an agreement was reached today between the university and UCU colleagues.

item.title: Staff Excellence Awards
item.description: Our staff winners were presented with awards at a ceremony on Monday 2 November 2026.

item.title: Act of Remembrance, Wednesday 11 November at 11am
item.description: Students and staff across the university are invited to participate in the Act of Remembrance by observing a two-minute silence at 11am on Wednesday 11 November 2026 in memory of all those who have died in armed conflict.

item.title: Sustainability Action Week
item.description: Get involved in free activities and engage with environmental issues to take action for the planet.

item.title: Take part in a short online survey about university reputation
item.description: The survey will take around 10 minutes to complete and you could win up to £100 in vouchers.

item.title: NottinghamHub will be temporarily unavailable
item.description: We are taking NottinghamHub offline for essential maintenance.

item.title: Apply now for a sustainable micro-internship
item.description: The U21 Sustainable Micro-Internships are a two-week online programme where you will collaborate with students from across the globe to provide a solution to one or more of the UN Sustainable Development Goals.

item.title: Anti-racism training
item.description: Free sessions to help you understand and challenge racism.
